ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is titled "Food Chains in Tundra." In the middle row, the sequence of arrows goes from the sun to a pale plant/lichen-like item, then to a white bunny, then to a bear, and finally to mushrooms. Reasoning: In a food chain, arrows show energy or food moving from what is eaten to the consumer. The arrow pointing into the bunny comes from the plant/lichen-like item, so the bunny consumes plant products.
